expected: install projects only manifest-tracked assets; a consumer repo's non-manifest AGENTS.md is operator/repo content and must never be clobbered. Repo damage was reverted via git checkout.
notes: Found as uncommitted drift in a consumer game repo before a release publish; content header of the clobbered file matches the generated public/data/AGENTS.md banner, proving the writer was public install.
repro: In a workspace with a consumer repo under repos/ that carries its own hand-authored AGENTS.md, run: dadaia public install --target all. Then: git -C repos/<slug> status --short shows AGENTS.md modified (generic content) and CLAUDE.md untracked.
symptom: A consumer repo's repo-specific AGENTS.md (header states it is NOT lib-originated and will not be overwritten) was replaced in the working tree by the generated workspace-root AGENTS.md, and a CLAUDE.md bridge file was dropped at the repo root. The repo-level AGENTS.md is not listed in .dadaia/agentic/manifest.json, so the write was an untracked projection.
title: public install overwrites a consumer repo's hand-authored AGENTS.md with the generic workspace AGENTS.md
